evaluations.evidence: search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting
evaluations.rationale: Backlog lacks complementary stories for ingesting/creating the music catalog and generating/storing fingerprints needed for identification-based search.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on my profile
evaluations.rationale: Requires user profile creation/management and preference capture; backlog has no stories to create/update profiles or collect listening history/preferences.

evaluations.evidence: based on other users similar to myself
evaluations.rationale: Similarity-based discovery presumes user profiles/behavior data and a way to compute similarity; backlog lacks stories to create/maintain those user datasets.

evaluations.evidence: similar to a given music video based on content similarity
evaluations.rationale: Content-similarity search presumes a repository of videos and extracted features; backlog lacks stories for ingesting music videos and computing/storing similarity features.

evaluations.evidence: exploiting enriched metadata and image tags
evaluations.rationale: Depends on metadata/tag enrichment pipelines and storage; backlog has upload of tagged videos but no explicit stories to enrich metadata or generate image tags at scale.

evaluations.evidence: upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps
evaluations.rationale: Provides a creation/ingestion capability (upload + tags) that complements many downstream processing stories; no obvious missing prerequisite is exposed by this story itself.

evaluations.evidence: view thumbnail sequences of video segments
evaluations.rationale: Viewing thumbnail sequences presumes segmentation exists and thumbnails are generated; backlog has admin segmentation editing but no story to generate thumbnails from segments.

evaluations.evidence: get info about similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Requires similarity computation/indexing for videos/segments; backlog lacks complementary stories to compute/store similarity relationships for retrieval.

evaluations.evidence: info about perceptually similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Perceptual similarity requires extracted perceptual features and an index; backlog does not include stories to generate and maintain these features/indices.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations from similar profiles
evaluations.rationale: Recommendations from similar profiles require profile creation/maintenance and interaction data; backlog lacks stories to create/update profiles and collect signals.

evaluations.evidence: recommendations based on most relevant news events in my area
evaluations.rationale: Requires location acquisition and a news-events feed/ingestion plus relevance ranking; backlog has no stories to obtain user location or ingest/maintain local news events.

evaluations.evidence: identify persons in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Needs a person-identity knowledge base and a way to link recognized persons to 'related information'; backlog lacks stories to curate/ingest person info sources.

evaluations.evidence: identify products in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Requires a product catalog/knowledge base and linkage from detections to product info; backlog lacks complementary stories to ingest/maintain product information.

evaluations.evidence: identify broadcaster logos in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Logo identification typically needs a reference logo database and associated broadcaster info; backlog lacks stories to create/maintain that reference data.

evaluations.evidence: identify brands in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Requires a brand knowledge base and mapping from detections to brand info; backlog does not include stories to ingest/maintain brand data sources.

evaluations.evidence: take a picture or upload an image, so that I am recommended with videos related to that picture
evaluations.rationale: Needs image upload/capture plus an image-to-video similarity/recommendation pipeline and a video corpus; backlog lacks explicit stories for image ingestion/storage and similarity indexing.

evaluations.evidence: access content using a geographical map and be informed if there are videos covering the area
evaluations.rationale: Requires videos to have geolocation metadata and a geospatial index; backlog lacks stories to capture/assign geotags to videos or manage POI datasets.

evaluations.evidence: search content items using automatic speech recognition
evaluations.rationale: ASR search requires generating/storing transcripts and indexing them; backlog lacks complementary stories to run ASR on ingested audio/video and persist transcripts.

evaluations.evidence: see, validate and edit segmentation of videos
evaluations.rationale: Editing/validating segmentation presumes segmentation is produced first; backlog lacks a story to automatically generate initial video segmentation for admins to review.

evaluations.evidence: annotate news video segments and extract a topic for each segment
evaluations.rationale: Requires existence of 'news video segments' (segmentation) and a topic taxonomy/model; backlog lacks explicit creation of segments for news and topic schema management.

evaluations.evidence: filter and rank videos based on A/V quality aspects
evaluations.rationale: Filtering/ranking requires computed A/V quality metrics per video; backlog lacks stories to compute/store those quality scores.

evaluations.evidence: quick assessment of whether audio material has been edited before the upload
evaluations.rationale: Assessment implies an analysis pipeline and presentation of results; backlog lacks complementary stories to run the detection and store/display the outcome per upload.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter nudity content
evaluations.rationale: Prefiltering requires a moderation workflow outcome (e.g., block/quarantine/flag) and integration with ingestion; backlog lacks stories defining what happens to flagged content.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter content using search based on low­level asset information
evaluations.rationale: Requires low-level asset features to be extracted and indexed; backlog lacks stories to compute/store those low-level features for search.

evaluations.evidence: validated the ingested contents for copyright infringement
evaluations.rationale: Copyright validation requires reference databases (fingerprints/rights data) and an enforcement workflow; backlog lacks stories to ingest/maintain reference rights data and define actions on infringement.

evaluations.evidence: search on high­level asset information such as metadata and tags either recognized by the system or provided by the user
evaluations.rationale: System-recognized high-level metadata/tags require extraction/enrichment pipelines; backlog includes user-provided tags (ZO-006) but lacks stories to recognize/extract tags automatically.

evaluations.evidence: based on automated analysis, citizen annotations, and comments on Talk
evaluations.rationale: Depends on collecting citizen annotations and Talk comments and running automated analysis; backlog lacks stories to create/capture those annotations/comments and to perform the automated analysis feeding this assessment.

evaluations.evidence: based on annotations and information from Talk comments
evaluations.rationale: Requires underlying annotation capture and Talk comment data availability; backlog lacks stories to create/manage annotations and Talk comments that this detection relies on.

evaluations.evidence: identify volunteer types
evaluations.rationale: Identifying volunteer types requires volunteer profile/activity data and a classification scheme; backlog lacks stories to collect/maintain volunteer attributes/behavior needed for typing.

evaluations.evidence: preclassify the Galaxy Zoo images using simple low­level image features
evaluations.rationale: Preclassification requires an image ingestion pipeline and feature extraction/storage; backlog lacks explicit stories to ingest Galaxy Zoo images and compute/store low-level features.

evaluations.evidence: detect Snapshot Serengeti images with no classifiable animals
evaluations.rationale: Requires Snapshot Serengeti image ingestion and a detection pipeline; backlog lacks complementary stories to ingest/manage the image dataset and persist detection results.

evaluations.evidence: automatic image series detection ... timestamping malfunction
evaluations.rationale: Requires access to image metadata/timestamps and a workflow to correct/flag malfunctions; backlog lacks stories to manage/correct timestamps or apply detected series to the dataset.

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal species preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Needs labeled training data/model management and ingestion of Snapshot Serengeti images; backlog lacks complementary stories for training/label acquisition and dataset ingestion.

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal attribute preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Requires attribute schema and training/label data plus ingestion; backlog lacks stories to define/maintain attributes and obtain labels/models.

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal number detection in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Counting animals requires detection models and evaluation/label data; backlog lacks complementary stories for model training/labeling and applying results to workflow.

evaluations.evidence: automatic segmentation or localization of plankton in Plankton Portal
evaluations.rationale: Requires Plankton Portal image ingestion and a way to store/use segmentation outputs; backlog lacks stories for dataset ingestion and downstream use of segmentation masks.

evaluations.evidence: detect Plankton Portal images with no classifiable plankton
evaluations.rationale: Depends on ingestion of Plankton Portal images and a workflow for handling 'no plankton' results; backlog lacks complementary ingestion and result-handling stories.

evaluations.evidence: detection of plankton size or orientation
evaluations.rationale: Requires localization/segmentation outputs or measurement pipeline and storage; backlog lacks complementary stories to compute and persist size/orientation per subject for use.

evaluations.evidence: automatic preclassification of plankton species
evaluations.rationale: Requires species taxonomy and trained models/labels plus ingestion; backlog lacks stories for taxonomy/label management and model training/application lifecycle.

evaluations.evidence: worm motion analysis to reduce video duration in Worm Watch Lab
evaluations.rationale: Reducing duration implies a video processing pipeline that outputs trimmed videos and replaces/links them in the system; backlog lacks complementary stories for producing and managing the reduced videos.

evaluations.evidence: detect the time ... where the worm lays an egg
evaluations.rationale: Requires Worm Watch Lab video ingestion and a way to store/use detected timestamps (e.g., annotations/markers); backlog lacks complementary stories for ingesting videos and persisting markers.

evaluations.evidence: detect important features ... in the satellite images
evaluations.rationale: Requires satellite image ingestion and a workflow to present/use detected features (labels/overlays); backlog lacks complementary stories for ingesting satellite imagery and surfacing detections.

evaluations.evidence: assess the probability/weight of a volunteer’s classification based on their experience
evaluations.rationale: Requires capturing volunteer experience metrics and classification history; backlog lacks stories to record/maintain volunteer experience and link it to classifications.

evaluations.evidence: prefiltering of the images to remove artefacts
evaluations.rationale: Removing artefacts implies an image processing pipeline and storage of cleaned outputs; backlog lacks complementary stories for applying the cleaning and managing resulting images.

evaluations.evidence: detect moving and transient objects in the images
evaluations.rationale: Requires image ingestion and a mechanism to store/visualize detections for downstream use; backlog lacks complementary stories for managing detection outputs.

evaluations.evidence: remove background noise and distracting sounds from the audio files
evaluations.rationale: Noise removal implies producing cleaned audio and integrating it into the system; backlog lacks complementary stories for generating/storing cleaned audio versions and selecting them for use.

evaluations.evidence: group whale calls that are similar
evaluations.rationale: Grouping requires extracted audio features/embeddings and a corpus of whale-call audio; backlog lacks complementary stories for ingesting whale-call audio and computing similarity features.

evaluations.evidence: identify the number of whales heard in a single audio file
evaluations.rationale: Requires whale-call audio ingestion and a counting/detection pipeline with stored results; backlog lacks complementary stories for ingesting audio files and persisting counts per file.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should interrupt a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Requires a defined interruption mechanism/channel and triggers based on volunteer activity; backlog lacks stories to deliver interruptions to volunteers and capture the needed activity signals.

evaluations.evidence: interrupt a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Selecting modality presumes the system can actually send text/image/video interruptions in the volunteer UI; backlog lacks complementary stories implementing the interruption delivery capability.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should educate a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Requires an education delivery workflow and triggers based on volunteer behavior/performance; backlog lacks stories to deliver education and to capture performance signals.

evaluations.evidence: educate a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Requires capability to deliver educational content in the volunteer experience; backlog lacks complementary stories for the education content delivery mechanism.

evaluations.evidence: which piece of education I should give to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Requires an education content library to choose from; backlog lacks stories to create/manage the set of educational 'pieces' (content items) referenced here.

evaluations.evidence: when a volunteer has made an interesting comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Requires existence of volunteer comments and a way to capture them; backlog lacks complementary stories for volunteers to create comments and for the system to store/access them.

evaluations.evidence: when Zoonibot should comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Requires Zoonibot capability to post comments and access to subjects/comments context; backlog lacks complementary stories implementing Zoonibot posting/integration with Talk.

evaluations.evidence: when Zoonibot should give an explanation
evaluations.rationale: Requires a mechanism for Zoonibot to deliver explanations and a repository of explanations; backlog lacks complementary stories for explanation delivery/content management.

evaluations.evidence: what Zoonibot should say to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Presumes Zoonibot exists and can message volunteers; backlog lacks complementary stories to implement Zoonibot messaging/commenting channels and manage message templates/content.

evaluations.evidence: group subjects by similarity
evaluations.rationale: Grouping by similarity requires subject feature extraction and similarity computation/indexing; backlog lacks complementary stories to compute/store similarity features for subjects.

evaluations.evidence: recommend different projects to volunteers based on their previous experiences
evaluations.rationale: Requires tracking volunteer project history/experience and a project catalog; backlog lacks stories to record volunteer experiences and maintain the project metadata needed for recommendation.

evaluations.evidence: see a summary of articles, so that I reuse them
evaluations.rationale: Summarizing/reusing articles presumes articles are created/ingested and stored; backlog lacks complementary stories for creating/importing articles and managing an article repository.
